rules: Do NOT modify tasks.json or progress.md
All script paths use $RALPH_DIR in bash, RALPH_DIR in python
No external Python dependencies except dotenv
bash -n ralph.sh must pass after changes
Commit with message format: feat(TASK_ID): title

tasks.title: Create ralph-dev repo structure
tasks.description: Done manually. Initial structure with ralph.sh, scripts/, templates/.
acceptance_criteria: ralph-dev repo exists with all files

tasks.title: Make ralph.sh project-agnostic
tasks.description: Done. RALPH_DIR/PROJECT_DIR separation, all paths fixed.
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded project paths in ralph.sh

tasks.title: AGENTS.md and project docs for ralph-dev
tasks.description: Done. AGENTS.md describes ralph architecture and rules.

tasks.title: Create test project for ralph validation
tasks.description: Create a minimal Python project (test-ralph-app/) next to ralph-dev/ to validate ralph works end-to-end on a fresh project. The test project should have: a simple Python module, pytest tests, Makefile with 'make test', and be initialized with ralph-init.sh.
acceptance_criteria: test-ralph-app/ exists as separate git repo
Has at least 1 Python file and 1 test
ralph-init.sh creates AGENTS.md, tasks.json, progress.md in it

tasks.title: Fix bot PROJECT_DIR for external projects
tasks.description: ralph_bot.py sets PROJECT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent which points to ralph-dev/. When bot runs for external project, PROJECT_DIR must point to the actual project. Add --project-dir CLI argument or read from env RALPH_PROJECT_DIR.
acceptance_criteria: STATE_FILE, TASKS_FILE, PROGRESS_FILE use correct PROJECT_DIR

tasks.title: Per-task timeout from tasks.json
tasks.description: Add optional 'timeout' field to tasks. Default 180s for simple, 600s for complex. ralph.sh reads timeout from task JSON and uses it for gtimeout.
acceptance_criteria: ralph.sh reads timeout field from task JSON

tasks.title: Bot: /cost command
tasks.description: Add /cost command that reads the current day's log file, sums token counts, and reports total tokens + estimated cost.
acceptance_criteria: Shows total tokens and estimated cost

tasks.title: Bot: /log shows ralph log tail
tasks.description: Change /log command to show tail of latest ralph log from logs/ directory instead of progress.md. /log 20 shows last 20 lines.

tasks.title: Bot: /tail live codex output
tasks.description: Add /tail command that sends last 20 lines of /tmp/ralph_coder_*.txt or /tmp/ralph_lead_*.txt — whichever was modified most recently.

tasks.title: Bot: /plan command
tasks.description: Add /plan command that shows formatted tasks.json summary grouped by phase with status indicators.

tasks.title: Bot: /add command
tasks.description: Add /add command to create new task from Telegram. Format: /add TASK-ID title | description. Adds to tasks.json with status pending.
acceptance_criteria: /add command parses task ID, title, description

tasks.title: Bot: /pause and /resume
tasks.description: Add /pause (writes pause to ralph_control.json, ralph stops between tasks) and /resume (writes continue).
acceptance_criteria: ralph.sh checks control file between tasks
